summary: # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Furniture Production P02 P2 - Creation of Pleated Cushions ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will demonstrate how to create pleated cushions using Marvelous Designer. We will cover the essential steps, from measuring to adjusting various parameters to achieve the desired look. ## Turning on Parts and Hiding Others After that, we can turn on the other parts and hide them to prevent them from participating in the simulation. ## Creating the Sofa Pad Wrapping Material Next, we can start to make the wrapping material of the sofa pad. ### Measuring the Length First, use the basic length measurement tool to measure the length by clicking on the outside of the electronic model. The side can also be measured. Click on one point first, then move to another point and double-click to complete the creation. ### Checking Total Length Use the editing measurement virtual model tool to select the measurement line to check the total length. ### Creating a Rectangular Sheet Create a rectangular sheet according to the measurement value, which should be slightly larger than the measurement size. Click on the positioning function in the upper right corner of the positioning ball to position the sheet to the sofa pad. ### Adjusting the Sheet Use the positioning ball to move the sheet to the top of the sofa pad. After moving, you can manually adjust the size to roughly cover the entire sofa pad. ## Adjusting the Edges For the front edge of the sofa pad, and for the back edge of the sofa pad, you can adjust the position by pressing the button in the right-duty and the button in the left-duty. There are two options for you to choose from; select the side edge by pressing the button in the left-duty. ### Creating the Side Edge Now, we will make the side edge. You can create a rectangle as a side edge according to the measurement method. You can also create a rectangular sheet as a side edge. ### Poking a Hole in the Side Edge Next, we can take the middle of the side edge and poke a hole in it to create a circle. Select a circle with the tool, and you can see the total length of these lines. ### Creating a Joint Plate Then create a total length x height of the plate. Create a joint plate so that the two rectangular plates can be edited simultaneously. Switch to the physical surface to see the opposite side. ## Adjusting Plate Orientation After arranging the position, since the bottom plate is now facing the back, turn the plate over on the surface to ensure that the front is facing the correct direction. ## Sewing the Edges Choose the free sewing tool. Click on the side of the long strip plate first, then create a sewing line along the side, double-click to complete the first half. Next, go to the rectangular plate, click along the side, determine the direction of the seam, and ensure that the front is facing the outside. Double-click to complete the creation. ### Handling Invisible Positions The bottom is the same; if you encounter an invisible position, you can change the perspective to continue clicking and double-clicking to complete the creation. ## Final Adjustments After adding to the side, the sewing line will arrange the rectangular plate on the sides of the two plates. After opening the simulation, because there are more model faces, there may be a problem of penetration, so drag it. Divide the line on the side as well. ### Enhancing Mesh Visibility The model face will be more visible, and the pattern will be more visible. Now reduce the vertical and horizontal distance between the plate and the model so that the mesh will be clearer and will not interfere with the model. Then reduce the thickness of the collision to shorten the distance between the plate and the model. ### Closing the Door Now, close the door and select the outer layer. Create an outer layer on the outer side of the dragon layer to create a fold for the seat position. ## Managing Sewing Lines Remove the sewing line created by the dragon layer. Since the sewing line is a whole circle, the excess part will be spread evenly on the four edges. Therefore, we have to sew one by one separately. ### Changing Sewing Line Type After sewing, change the type of sewing line to "Turned" so that the sewing edge is more even. Then change the fabric to the top layer, which will be convenient for applying some special effects later. ### Applying Pressure to the Outer Layer Apply pressure 5 to the outer layer of the board to make it inflatable. This step may need to be repeated to achieve the desired effect. ## Adjusting the Inner Layer Due to the current Stitchablites connection, if you change the outer layer, the inner layer will also change simultaneously. Therefore, modifications will be made after the Stitchablites challenge is completed. ### Managing Pressure Levels Since the 10,000-layer plate is relatively large, applying the correct pressure will create the desired effect. If you feel that the pressure is too obvious at 5, you can also lower it to 3 or below. ## Pleating Details Now we return the pressure to 5 to add some pleating details. Double-clamp the frame center, which is the point of contact, and widen the plate. Change the fabric to the usual leather fabric as it offers good bending strength. ### Adjusting Bending Strength If the bending strength is too high, the pleating details may be lost. You can reduce the bending strength of the golden tail and significantly reduce the bending strength of the right foot line to generate more detailed pleating. ### Tension Adjustments Adjusting the tension of the right foot line can maintain the pleating at the seam side while creating more or less pleating in the right foot line direction. If the strength of the fabric is low, the fabric will stretch more easily and spread more due to the pressure. ### Visualizing Effects On the contrary, if the ridge is larger, the fabric will not stretch easily. You can move to the side lens to see the effect. The spin can change the appearance, allowing you to observe the results closely. ## Managing Wrinkles Because the outer plate is stretched a lot along the tail, we can focus on the strength of the tail. When the tail strength is high, there will be many hard wrinkles on the tail, and if you turn it over, the wrinkles will disappear. ### Comparing Effects You can adjust the settings as needed to compare the effects. Reduce the particle strength to 5 to see more wrinkle details. If you feel that the wrinkles are insufficient, you can increase the strength of the tail. ### Finalizing the Model Show all models and rotate the model. Lower the surface tightness to prevent the air around the model from being reduced and affecting the fabric. ## Conclusion In this tutorial, we have covered the process of creating pleated cushions in Marvelous Designer. By following these steps, you can achieve detailed and realistic cushions for your furniture designs.
